difficulty.reason: Requires Google Trust & Safety verification, YouTube demo video, domain verification, and CASA Tier 2 security assessment.

timeEstimate.notes: Unverified apps can test with up to 100 manually specified test users, but public launch requires Cloud Verification and external security audits.

requirements: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) organization or project with billing enabled
Verified domain ownership in Google Search Console
Public Privacy Policy hosted on the verified domain detailing user data retention and deletion policies
Unlisted YouTube demonstration video showing the OAuth consent screen with client ID visible in the URL bar
Annual CASA (Cloud Application Security Assessment) Tier 2 audit for restricted scopes (e.g. Gmail full access)
Payment of third-party security lab audit fees ($500 - $3,000+ depending on scope tier)

steps.title: Create a GCP Project & Enable APIs
steps.description: Go to Google Cloud Console, create a new project, and enable the target APIs (e.g., Gmail API, Google Drive API, Google Calendar API) in the API Library.

steps.title: Configure OAuth Consent Screen
steps.description: Select User Type 'External'. Enter App Name, Support Email, Developer Email, and Authorized Domains (which must match your Google Search Console domain). Add requested sensitive or restricted scopes.

steps.title: Create OAuth 2.0 Web Client Credentials
steps.description: Under 'Credentials', click 'Create Credentials' > 'OAuth client ID'. Select 'Web application' and specify your Authorized Redirect URIs.

steps.title: Test with Internal / Test Users
steps.description: Before public verification, add up to 100 Google user email addresses under 'Test users' in the Consent Screen settings. These users can log in despite the unverified state.

steps.title: Prepare Verification Materials & Demo Video
steps.description: Record an unlisted YouTube video showing: 1) the browser address bar with client ID, 2) the consent flow, and 3) how your agent handles user data. Verify domain ownership in Google Search Console.

steps.title: Submit for Verification & Complete CASA Review
steps.description: Click 'Submit for Verification' in the GCP Console. Coordinate with Google Trust & Safety and complete the CASA security assessment with an authorized lab.

blockers.problem: Google Unverified App warning screen blocks users during authentication
blockers.solution: During development, testers can click 'Advanced' > 'Go to [App] (unsafe)'. In production, this screen only disappears after Google Trust & Safety approves your app.

blockers.problem: Verification application rejected because demo video does not show client ID
blockers.solution: Re-record the YouTube demo ensuring the browser URL bar is clearly readable and shows the full `client_id` query parameter during the OAuth redirect.

blockers.problem: Domain ownership mismatch with GCP project
blockers.solution: Ensure the domain registered in Google Search Console is verified by the exact same Google account that owns the GCP project.

blockers.problem: CASA Tier 2 security assessment costs and lead times
blockers.solution: Restricted scopes (like Gmail message modification) trigger mandatory third-party lab audits. Evaluate whether less sensitive scopes suffice or use a pre-verified managed provider.

agentCanDo: Generate code for OAuth 2.0 PKCE flow, state parameter validation, and token refresh logic
Draft the scope justification narrative and privacy disclosure copy required by Google Trust & Safety
Validate redirect URI formatting and client configuration
developerMustDo: Verify domain ownership in Google Search Console via DNS TXT records
Record, narrate, and upload the mandatory YouTube demo video
Complete legal attestation forms with Google Trust & Safety
Engage an authorized CASA security lab and pay required auditing fees

managedOption.managedSufficientWhen: Composio's pre-verified Google OAuth app is the fastest path when building AI assistants or agent tools that need Gmail, Calendar, or Drive access without spending weeks and thousands of dollars on CASA security assessments.
managedOption.customRequiredWhen: You must complete custom Google verification if your enterprise customers demand your specific brand name on the Google consent dialog, or if your enterprise security policy prohibits routing tokens through a third-party managed infrastructure.

sources.title: Google Cloud: OAuth App Verification FAQ
Google Identity: OAuth 2.0 for Web Server Applications

claims.claim: Apps requesting restricted Google scopes (such as Gmail API) must undergo an annual CASA Tier 2 security assessment.
Unverified apps can test with up to 100 pre-registered test users before verification is submitted.
Google requires a public or unlisted YouTube video showing the full URL bar and consent screen before granting sensitive scope approvals.

openQuestions: Does Google offer fee subsidies or waivers for early-stage bootstrapped AI agent startups undertaking CASA Tier 2 assessments?
